newsitem.title: USA: St.Petersburg stadium to be called Tropicana Field.
newsitem.headline: St.Petersburg stadium to be called Tropicana Field.

text.p: Tropicana Dole Beverages North America said Thursday it has an agreement with the Tampa Bay Devil Rays to rename the Thunderdome as Tropicana Field.
The Devil Rays has scheduled to begin major league baseball competition in 1998.
Seagram Co Ltd spokeswoman Amy Goldberger said terms of the naming rights agreement were not disclosed. Tropicana is a Seagram subsidiary.
As part of the agreement, the fabric roof of Tropicana Field will be illuminated orange in the evening.
The company said its shape suggests a giant orange.
The official Tropicana Field logo uses the familiar Tropicana brand script topped by an orange dome sectioned in the shape of an orange, it said.
